name: tokyo-tower
description: A Tokyo night behind your Claude Code chat, cinematic or pixel-art: Tokyo Tower shines bright on a fresh context and dims as the context window fills up

style.title: Style
style.description: cinematic: smooth vector city with a GPU film pass (bloom, haze, grain). pixel: the original pixel-art scene.

film.title: Film effect
film.description: cinematic style only: play the GPU film pass (bloom, haze, grain) over the scene. Off shows the plain vector scene.
